name: ACT vehicle registration concession
summary: No registration fees on one light vehicle for Canberra holders of a Low Income Health Care Card or Pensioner Concession Card.
key: Holders of a current Services Australia Pensioner Concession Card or Low Income Health Care Card pay zero registration fees.
who: Holder of a current Services Australia Pensioner Concession Card or Low Income Health Care Card
One light vehicle or light trailer registered in the cardholder's name
how: Bring proof of identity and your concession card to an Access Canberra Service Centre.
First-time claims need a concession validation consent form.
catches: You still pay full fees for other components, including the MAI insurance premium.
The page names the Low Income Health Care Card, not the Health Care Card issued with Youth Allowance or Austudy; check with Access Canberra.

source.label: Access Canberra: Concessions for registration fees
